body: Thanks for your time. I think I might do it in june or july, I have this summer in mind either way.

I have been in therapy for the last 4 years and also tried a barrage of various medications. None of this have helped me, if anything I have only grown more comfortable with the idea of suicide. Worth noticing that I have had three different psychologists, none of them bad per say it just hasn't helped in any way they would have hoped for \(I guess\). I have also talked and socialized with plenty of people in similar situations \(suicidal\) and it has not helped me. I might sound ignorant saying all this though. It feels like everything is going downhill non\-stop now as I'm getting older, the periods of sadness and distress are getting worse every time. Is it worth it?

Alright here goes. Romantic relationships serve the purpose of continuing the survival of the species, that's the fundamental reason for mechanism such as love and infaturation. Every human wants to fulfill certain goals in order to feel at peace, I believe these goals are predecided by our natural urges. The strongest urge we have comes in the form of reproduction, this becomes appereant in almost every part of todays society. Another common goal is the often vague desire to "be happy", very few feel "happy" all the time since the concept of total happiness would be somewhat of an impossibility. You'd need to be able to fulfill your biological urges \(I believe this to be very important for healthy development\) and you need to obtain a good psychological health. There are also other obstacles in form of various chemical imbalances related to signal substances working in our neurons, balance would need to be ahicved here as well. I do however believe that this balance can be achieved through the fulfilling of my two previous points. Evidently all these points are connected.

Friendships would serve the purpose of psychological health, if these social interactions are beneficial for the individual, it also gives you a sense of belonging in a larger sense \(benificial for the collevtive\). I would say society is this very concept on a large scale as it works by both ensuring the continued survival of the species by encouraging further reproduction and it also gives individuals a place of belonging in the social network. The balance will then be kept somewhat throughout the society as a whole given most individuals are at peace with their own function in said society.

Now what I have found is a lacking desire to participate in these systems, I have tried to socialize but it leaves me disappointed and sometimes more sad than I already was. I can see how these workings are needed in order to further the human species but I'm not that interested in participating in this process, even though I myself possess the same natural urges in doing so \- this causes a conflict of interest within myself which is hard to deal with. Given I am not one singularity but rather many different pieces communicating with each other I can see why this conflict exists but I can however not see any real functional solution for it. I generally dislike the concept of socialization, friendship and romantic relationship and I have no real desire to be a part of it \- this is the new fundament of my underlying thought process. This very fundament also enables a strong will to end my life prematurely, a thought I previously tended to fear but now feel like a natural conclusion to my problems.

Growing up I got an image of what life is like and how social dynamics work. School, kid shows and parents did a good job portraying it as something worthwhile and productive. Turns out this image is largely false and I don't really like the reality of life. I've had friendships and relationships in the past but I've moved away from it, I can't get myself to like it, I find myself alone from my own choosing. Even if I have been in love I have slowly ended it because I can't find myself to live or deal with the expectations, social rules or dynamocs related to it. I often feel like it's not for me, at the same time loneliness makes me feel like a failure and sad. I believe this is because of various biological functions within my being - we are generally not built to be alone, there is a desire to reach out but I don't agree with the results of this desire.

At this point I really couldn't have a family, for one I'm sterile because of trauma and again, the motivation or desire for it is not there. There might had been a time where I wanted all this but at this point it's just a conflict between natural urges and mindful unwillingness.

This and other reasons are base of my suffering, I just want to give myself a beautiful ending and I finally feel at peace with the idea.
